CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.funktion_match_document_chunks(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 20, filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, content text, metadata jsonb, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_match_count integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(match_count, 20), 1), 50);
    v_filter jsonb := COALESCE(filter, '{}'::jsonb);
BEGIN
    PERFORM set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'strict_order', true);
    PERFORM set_config('hnsw.ef_search', '120', true);

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH prepared AS (
        SELECT
            dc.id,
            dc.chunk_text AS content,
            COALESCE(dc.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
                || jsonb_build_object(
                    'source_type', dc.source_type,
                    'source_ref', dc.source_ref,
                    'audience', dc.audience,
                    'chunk_type', COALESCE(dc.metadata->>'chunk_type', 'content'),
                    'title', COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(dc.metadata->>'title', ''),
                        NULLIF(dc.metadata->>'file_name', ''),
                        dc.source_ref
                    ),
                    'url', COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(dc.metadata->>'url', ''),
                        NULLIF(dc.metadata->>'sharepoint_url', '')
                    )
                ) AS metadata,
            1 - (dc.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity,
            dc.embedding <=> query_embedding AS distance
        FROM public.document_chunks AS dc
        WHERE dc.embedding IS NOT NULL
          AND dc.audience IN ('public', 'it_internal')
          AND COALESCE(dc.metadata->>'chunk_type', 'content') <> 'header'
    )
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.content,
        p.metadata,
        p.similarity
    FROM prepared AS p
    WHERE v_filter = '{}'::jsonb
       OR p.metadata @> v_filter
    ORDER BY p.distance
    LIMIT v_match_count;
END;
$function$

funktionen.name: funktion_rag_suche_chunks
funktionen.quelltext:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.funktion_rag_suche_chunks(p_query_embedding vector, p_audiences text[], p_match_count integer DEFAULT 8, p_source_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_min_similarity double precision DEFAULT 0.30)
 RETURNS TABLE(chunk_id uuid, chunk_text text, source_type text, source_ref text, title text, audience text, source_updated_at timestamp with time zone, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_allowed constant text[] := ARRAY['public','it_internal'];
BEGIN
  IF p_audiences IS NULL OR array_length(p_audiences, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'funktion_rag_suche_chunks: p_audiences ist Pflicht und darf nicht leer sein';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p_audiences) a WHERE a <> ALL (v_allowed)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'funktion_rag_suche_chunks: unzulaessiger audience-Wert';
  END IF;

  IF p_match_count IS NULL OR p_match_count < 1 OR p_match_count > 30 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'funktion_rag_suche_chunks: p_match_count muss zwischen 1 und 30 liegen';
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'strict_order', true);

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.chunk_text,
    c.source_type,
    c.source_ref,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata->>'title',''),
             NULLIF(c.metadata->>'file_name',''),
             c.source_ref)                                   AS title,
    c.audience,
    NULLIF(c.metadata->>'source_updated_at','')::timestamptz AS source_updated_at,
    1 - (c.embedding <=> p_query_embedding)                  AS similarity
  FROM public.document_chunks c
  WHERE c.audience = ANY (p_audiences)
    AND (p_source_types IS NULL OR c.source_type = ANY (p_source_types))
    AND 1 - (c.embedding <=> p_query_embedding) >= p_min_similarity
  ORDER BY c.embedding <=> p_query_embedding
  LIMIT p_match_count;
END;
$function$

funktionen.name: jira_agent_collect_context
funktionen.quelltext:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jira_agent_collect_context(p_query_text text, p_query_embedding_text text, p_current_ticket_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_rag_count integer DEFAULT 12, p_public_rag_count integer DEFAULT 6, p_table_count integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
with params as (
  select
    coalesce(nullif(trim(p_query_text), ''), 'IT Support') as q,
    p_query_embedding_text::extensions.vector(1536) as emb,
    greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_rag_count, 12), 25)) as rag_limit,
    greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_public_rag_count, 6), 15)) as public_limit,
    greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_table_count, 5), 10)) as table_limit
),
-- OR-verknuepfte tsquery aus den Lexemen des Ticket-Textes
tsq as (
  select coalesce(
    nullif(
      array_to_string(
        array(
          select quote_literal(l.lexeme)
          from unnest(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, (select q from params))) as l
          where length(l.lexeme) > 2
          limit 40
        ),
        ' | '
      ),
      ''
    ),
    quote_literal('support')
  ) as raw
),
query_ts as (
  select to_tsquery('german'::regconfig, (select raw from tsq)) as tq
),
-- ---------- RAG (alle Audiences) ----------
rag_vector as (
  select dc.id,
         row_number() over (order by dc.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) p.emb) as rank_v,
         (1 - (dc.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) p.emb))::float as vector_sim
  from public.document_chunks dc
  cross join params p
  where dc.embedding is not null
  order by dc.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) p.emb
  limit (select rag_limit * 3 from params)
),
rag_text as (
  select dc.id,
         row_number() over (
           order by ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, dc.chunk_text), (select tq from query_ts)) desc
         ) as rank_t,
         ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, dc.chunk_text), (select tq from query_ts))::float as text_rank
  from public.document_chunks dc
  where to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, dc.chunk_text) @@ (select tq from query_ts)
  order by text_rank desc
  limit (select rag_limit * 3 from params)
),
rag_combined as (
  select coalesce(v.id, t.id) as id,
         (coalesce(1.0 / (60 + v.rank_v), 0.0) + coalesce(1.0 / (60 + t.rank_t), 0.0))::float as rrf_score,
         coalesce(v.vector_sim, 0)::float as vector_sim,
         coalesce(t.text_rank, 0)::float as text_rank
  from rag_vector v
  full outer join rag_text t on t.id = v.id
),
rag_final as (
  select dc.source_type, dc.source_ref, dc.audience,
         left(dc.chunk_text, 5000) as chunk_text,
         dc.metadata, rc.rrf_score, rc.vector_sim, rc.text_rank
  from rag_combined rc
  join public.document_chunks dc on dc.id = rc.id
  order by rc.rrf_score desc
  limit (select rag_limit from params)
),
-- ---------- RAG nur audience = 'public' ----------
pub_vector as (
  select dc.id,
         row_number() over (order by dc.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) p.emb) as rank_v,
         (1 - (dc.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) p.emb))::float as vector_sim
  from public.document_chunks dc
  cross join params p
  where dc.embedding is not null
    and dc.audience = 'public'
  order by dc.embedding operator(extensions.<=>) p.emb
  limit (select public_limit * 3 from params)
),
pub_text as (
  select dc.id,
         row_number() over (
           order by ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, dc.chunk_text), (select tq from query_ts)) desc
         ) as rank_t,
         ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, dc.chunk_text), (select tq from query_ts))::float as text_rank
  from public.document_chunks dc
  where dc.audience = 'public'
    and to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, dc.chunk_text) @@ (select tq from query_ts)
  order by text_rank desc
  limit (select public_limit * 3 from params)
),
pub_combined as (
  select coalesce(v.id, t.id) as id,
         (coalesce(1.0 / (60 + v.rank_v), 0.0) + coalesce(1.0 / (60 + t.rank_t), 0.0))::float as rrf_score,
         coalesce(v.vector_sim, 0)::float as vector_sim
  from pub_vector v
  full outer join pub_text t on t.id = v.id
),
pub_final as (
  select dc.source_type, dc.source_ref, dc.audience,
         left(dc.chunk_text, 3000) as chunk_text,
         pc.rrf_score, pc.vector_sim
  from pub_combined pc
  join public.document_chunks dc on dc.id = pc.id
  where dc.audience = 'public'
  order by pc.rrf_score desc
  limit (select public_limit from params)
),
-- ---------- Direkte Tabellentreffer ----------
jira_ranked as (
  select jt.ticket_key, jt.summary, jt.audience,
         left(coalesce(jt.description, ''), 4000) as description,
         jt.status, jt.resolution, jt.priority, jt.issue_type,
         left(coalesce(jt.comments::text, ''), 4000) as comments,
         ts_rank_cd(
           to_tsvector('german'::regconfig,
             coalesce(jt.summary,'') || ' ' || coalesce(jt.description,'') || ' ' ||
             coalesce(jt.resolution,'') || ' ' || coalesce(jt.comments::text,'')),
           (select tq from query_ts)
         )::float as score
  from public.jira_tickets jt
  where (p_current_ticket_key is null or jt.ticket_key <> p_current_ticket_key)
    and to_tsvector('german'::regconfig,
          coalesce(jt.summary,'') || ' ' || coalesce(jt.description,'') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(jt.resolution,'') || ' ' || coalesce(jt.comments::text,''))
        @@ (select tq from query_ts)
  order by score desc
  limit (select table_limit from params)
),
confluence_ranked as (
  select cp.page_id, cp.title, cp.space_key, cp.page_url, cp.labels, cp.audience,
         left(coalesce(cp.content_text, ''), 4000) as content_text,
         ts_rank_cd(
           to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(cp.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(cp.content_text,'')),
           (select tq from query_ts)
         )::float as score
  from public.confluence_pages cp
  where to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(cp.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(cp.content_text,''))
        @@ (select tq from query_ts)
  order by score desc
  limit (select table_limit from params)
),
sharepoint_ranked as (
  select sp.doc_id, sp.file_name, sp.file_path, sp.sharepoint_url,
         sp.department, sp.content_type, sp.sensitivity_label, sp.tags, sp.audience,
         left(coalesce(sp.content_text, ''), 4000) as content_text,
         ts_rank_cd(
           to_tsvector('german'::regconfig,
             coalesce(sp.file_name,'') || ' ' || coalesce(sp.content_text,'') || ' ' ||
             coalesce(sp.department,'') || ' ' || coalesce(sp.tags::text,'')),
           (select tq from query_ts)
         )::float as score
  from public.sharepoint_documents sp
  where to_tsvector('german'::regconfig,
          coalesce(sp.file_name,'') || ' ' || coalesce(sp.content_text,'') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(sp.department,'') || ' ' || coalesce(sp.tags::text,''))
        @@ (select tq from query_ts)
  order by score desc
  limit (select table_limit from params)
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'query', (select q from params),
  'rag', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'source_type', source_type, 'source_ref', source_ref, 'audience', audience,
      'chunk_text', chunk_text, 'metadata', metadata,
      'rrf_score', rrf_score, 'vector_sim', vector_sim, 'text_rank', text_rank
    ) order by rrf_score desc) from rag_final), '[]'::jsonb),
  'public_rag', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'source_type', source_type, 'source_ref', source_ref, 'audience', audience,
      'chunk_text', chunk_text, 'rrf_score', rrf_score, 'vector_sim', vector_sim
    ) order by rrf_score desc) from pub_final), '[]'::jsonb),
  'jira', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'ticket_key', ticket_key, 'summary', summary, 'audience', audience,
      'description', description, 'status', status, 'resolution', resolution,
      'priority', priority, 'issue_type', issue_type, 'comments', comments, 'score', score
    ) order by score desc) from jira_ranked), '[]'::jsonb),
  'confluence', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'page_id', page_id, 'title', title, 'space_key', space_key, 'page_url', page_url,
      'labels', labels, 'audience', audience, 'content_text', content_text, 'score', score
    ) order by score desc) from confluence_ranked), '[]'::jsonb),
  'sharepoint', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'doc_id', doc_id, 'file_name', file_name, 'file_path', file_path,
      'sharepoint_url', sharepoint_url, 'department', department, 'content_type', content_type,
      'sensitivity_label', sensitivity_label, 'tags', tags, 'audience', audience,
      'content_text', content_text, 'score', score
    ) order by score desc) from sharepoint_ranked), '[]'::jsonb)
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_documents(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, content text, metadata jsonb, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  return query
  select
    d.id,
    d.content,
    d.metadata,
    1 - (d.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  from public.documents d
  where d.metadata @> filter
  order by d.embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count;
end;
$function$
